digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI (+ Mgombato doka)
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: same name 'Mbugubugu' (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: A climber with fleshy, five-angled stems that snap easily, the third Cissus that Digo people call 'breaking'.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina ya nyama yenye pembe tano yanayokatika kwa urahisi, *Cissus* wa tatu ambaye Wadigo humwita 'kukatika'.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaokpwera wenye milita ya nyama ya pembe tsano inayodoka upesi; ni *Cissus* wa hahu ambao Adigo anauiha 'kudoka'.

summary.en: This mdokadoka is a succulent Cissus with five-angled stems. It shares its two Digo names with two other Cissus species.
summary.sw: Mdokadoka huu ni *Cissus* wenye maji mengi na mashina yenye pembe tano. Unashiriki majina yake mawili ya Kidigo na spishi nyingine mbili za *Cissus*.
summary.dg: *Mdokadoka* hinyu ni *Cissus* wenye madzi manji ndani na milita ya pembe tsano. Unashiriki madzinage mairi ga Chidigo na aina mbiri zanjina za *Cissus*.

about.en: *Cissus quinquangularis* is a succulent climber with tendrils. Its name means 'five-angled', describing the fleshy green stems, which are ridged along their length. The leaves are small, fleshy and often short-lived, so the green stems do much of the plant's work. Small greenish flowers are followed by small berries. As with the other *mdokadoka*, the jointed stem breaks easily, and Digo people recognise the plant by its stem.
about.sw: *Cissus quinquangularis* ni mtambaa wenye maji mengi na vikonyo. Jina lake linamaanisha 'wenye pembe tano', likieleza mashina yake ya kijani yenye nyama, yenye mifereji kwa urefu wake wote. Majani ni madogo, yenye nyama na mara nyingi hayadumu muda mrefu, kwa hiyo mashina ya kijani ndiyo hufanya sehemu kubwa ya kazi ya mmea. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-kijani hufuatwa na matunda madogo. Kama ilivyo kwa *mdokadoka* wengine, shina lenye viungo hukatika kwa urahisi, na Wadigo huutambua mmea huu kwa shina lake.
about.dg: *Cissus quinquangularis* ni mmea unaokpwera wenye madzi manji ndani, na una nyuzi za kugbwirira. Dzinare rina mana ya 'renye pembe tsano', kpwa sababu ya militaye ya nyama ya chijani, yenye mistari mire ya kufutuka kpwa urewe wosi. Makodza ni madide, ga nyama, na mara nyinji tagakala kpwa muda mure, kpwa hivyo milita ya chijani ndiyo inayohenda kazi nyinji ya mmea. Maruwa madide ga chijani ganalavya matunda madide. Dza *mdokadoka* wanjina, kolo renye vitengu nkudoka upesi, na Adigo anaumanya mmea kpwa kolore.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and thicket, scrambling over shrubs.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika kavu ya vichaka na vichaka, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kavu na vitsakani, uchiambala dzulu ya vitsaka.

culture.en: The two Digo names describe the stem and the habit. *Mdokadoka*, 'breaking', comes from *doka*, to break, because the stem snaps easily. *Mbugubugu*, 'climber', is the basic name for climbing plants, and repeating the root *-bugu* stresses the climbing form.
culture.sw: Majina mawili ya Kidigo yanaeleza shina na mtindo wa ukuaji wake. *Mdokadoka*, 'kukatika', linatokana na *doka*, kukatika, kwa sababu shina hukatika kwa urahisi. *Mbugubugu*, 'mtambaa', ni jina la msingi la mimea inayotambaa, na kurudia mzizi *-bugu* kunasisitiza umbo la kutambaa.
culture.dg: Madzina mairi ga Chidigo ganaeleza kolo na vira mmea unavyomera. *Mdokadoka*, 'kudoka', rinalavywa kula *doka*, kudoka, kpwa sababu kolo nkudoka upesi. *Mbugubugu*, 'mmea unaokpwera', ni dzina ra msingi ra mimea inayokpwera, na kurudiya muzi *-bugu* kunaonyesa hasa kukala mmea hinyu ni wa aina ya kukpwera.

names.en: Digo: *mdokadoka* and *mbugubugu*, the latter shared with Duruma and Giriama. Pakia gives the same two names to *Cissus rotundifolia* and *C. sylvicola*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdokadoka* na *mbugubugu*, la pili likishirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Pakia anatoa majina hayo hayo mawili kwa *Cissus rotundifolia* na *C. sylvicola*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdokadoka* na *mbugubugu*; dzina ra phiri ni ra Chiduruma na Chigiriama piya. Pakia anapha madzina higo mairi kpwa *Cissus rotundifolia* na *C. sylvicola*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

mgombato: doka to tear, to break off, to come apart (e.g. a piece of rope); kukatika.
